SetCurrentStep (executor.cc:2069-2101) now also calls ClearMtpDeferral() (53a08cb1) and RewindRings(max_step, new_step) (6cfd1a28, 2026-11-14); RewindRings (2176-2234): no rings (RingSlots()==0) or no backwards move -> OK; to the rewind point SaveCheckpoint marks (session_advanced.cc:515, SaveRewindPoint) it restores the ring copy KeepRewindWindow took before the first run that would overwrite that step's 512-position window (if one did); any other rewind of more than ring-512 positions fails FailedPrecondition. RingSlots (state.cc:1402-1412) is nonzero only when some caches have fewer slots than others. Same code in the release (6da75396 SetCurrentStep has both calls). So 'only moves current_step back' and 'copies no KV data' no longer hold unconditionally. The v0.18.0 comparison is dropped (Agello no longer ships it).
corrected_text: SessionAdvanced::RewindToCheckpoint restores the checkpoint's step, session state and task dependencies and drops later checkpoints, then calls the executor's SetCurrentStep, which moves current_step back, marks the MTP drafter unprimed and drops a deferred speculative round; when the KV caches include rings (some caches have fewer slots than others), it also puts back the ring copy taken before a run overwrote the window of the step SaveCheckpoint marked, and refuses a rewind of more than the ring's slots less 512 positions to any other step (ours: 6cfd1a28). Without rings, or when no run reached that far, a rewind copies no KV data and the refill overwrites the abandoned positions.
